messages:
Maya (marketing): quick ask for the webinar deck: can runtime run a super-small validation run to confirm our hero claim about '90% of users hit p95 < 350ms' for warmed sessions on hero-v2? we only need persuasive numbers + a tiny artifact pack.

Tomas (eng-runtime): sure. what's the exact definition of 'warmed session' here? do you want prefix-cached with a 1k token prime or full steady-state after many requests?

Maya (marketing): prefer a conservative warmed definition: prime with 1k token context, then 10 sequential requests from the same session. sample payloads below. if warmed fails, we'll fallback to citing cold numbers with an explanatory note.

Maya (marketing): payload (one-liner): ```json
{"prompt":"TL;DR these release notes into 3 bullets","context":"<~1k tokens>"}
```

Tomas (eng-runtime): ok. propose quick plan: - cold cohort: 500 independent requests seq=1024 - warmed cohort: 300 primed traces prime=1024 + 10 followups - variants: fp16 + int8-llm - hardware: 1 x A100 80GB - output: aggregated p50/p95/p99 CSV, 10 raw json examples per cell, and a tiny analysis notebook. should be ~60-90m.

Priya (product): also include a short quality check: grep for hallucination indicators and a small lexical similarity score vs baseline (5 samples each). we just want to ensure quantization didn't break outputs.

Tomas (eng-runtime): will add simple BLEU-lite and length checks. question: do you want bursty arrival patterns (simulate webinar demo load) like 50rps bursts for 60s?

Maya (marketing): yes, add one microburst scenario: 50 rps for 60s (50 concurrent simulated clients) but only for warmed variant. acceptance: p95 <= 350ms for warmed cohort and no >500ms outliers during burst >1% of requests.

Sam (data): i'll help with packaging: want CSV with columns: model, variant, cohort, sample_id, latency_ms, status, seed. also attach trace ids so eng can fetch full traces if needed.

Tomas (eng-runtime): sample CLI we'll use:```bash
# warmed primed
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-v2","variant":"int8-llm","prime":1024,"followups":10,"requests":300,"traces":true}'
# cold
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-v2","variant":"fp16","requests":500,"seq":1024}'
# burst
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-v2","variant":"int8-llm","burst_rps":50,"burst_dur_s":60}'
```

Tomas (eng-runtime): scheduling now. bench-bot will post artifacts when done. i'll tag this thread.

bench-bot: bench-job-1798881234 started by Tomas at 2025-09-10T09:40:00Z

Olivia (docs): heads up docs team may pull one sample for the blog screenshot. please make sure the sample has minor redaction for internal URLs.

Maya (marketing): thanks all. if warmed numbers pass acceptance we will use the warmed p95 in the headline and link to the artifact pack. if not, we need a quick note explaining the gap. please ping here with artifacts or a 1-line fail/pass by EOD tomorrow. :sparkles:
